metadata.title: Matchu Pura | Garo Style Beef & Pounded Rice Curry
metadata.description:
Click to tweet this recipe: https://clicktotweet.com/LPf1q

Phura (Pura) is Garo meat dish cooked on special occasions. Beef, Pork, Chicken or even fish meat is cooked along with pounded rice and lots of vegetables. Either bamboo shoots or roselle (galda gishi) is used to give it its tangy taste. This juicy, delicious, thick and tangy dish is my all time favorite.
